name: The Wedding Decision Kit
label: Wedding planning
headline: Know what you’re booking. Know what’s left to pay.
intro: Compare vendor quotes with fees included, track deposits and refunds, and keep the guest list and handover details in one Excel kit.
contents: 50 quote rows with guest-count scenarios, extras, service fees and tax assumptions.
25 selections, contract-total overrides and 100 payment or refund records. Deposits reduce the balance, not the agreed price.
Guest-party list, RSVP counts and tasks with owners, dates and handover notes.
Blank and fictional example workbooks, a five-page PDF guide with a fillable vendor worksheet, and a personal-use licence.
example: The fictional Cedar Hall quote totals 9,979.20. A 2,000 deposit and 200 refund leave 8,179.20 still to pay. See exactly how that works in the included example.
fit: For couples who want a practical Excel file for vendor decisions and payments. Uses one currency per workbook; fee and tax assumptions must match your vendor’s quote.
limits: 50 quotes, 25 selections and 100 rows each for payments, guest parties and tasks. Fixed formula ranges; do not insert extra rows.

name: Two Homes, One Organizer
label: Personal organization
headline: One place for the practical details of two homes.
intro: Keep planned and actual handovers, factual notes, shared expense allocations and essential contacts together in your own Excel file.
contents: 100 handover records with planned and actual timestamps. Actual elapsed hours appear only when both actual times are entered.
100 expenses and 100 reimbursement records, with partial payments, refunds and separate unsettled totals in each direction.
Dated notes, original-source references, follow-up actions and a contact directory.
Blank and fictional example workbooks, a six-page guide in A4 and US Letter, two fillable record forms in each guide, and a personal-use licence.
example: In the fictional example, a 120 expense with a 60% share for the person who paid allocates 48 to the other person. After 20 repaid and 5 refunded, 33 remains unsettled.
fit: For a parent organizing their own practical records using an existing arrangement. This is a personal organizer, not a shared messaging service, legal advice or a court submission kit.
limits: 100 rows per tracker. Actual time is calculated from local timestamps, with no timezone or daylight-saving adjustment. No legal entitlement or overnight calculations.
